SoundOff for Android: on-device recording and transcription with English, Filipino and mixed-language modes.

- Stop and Resume append to the same interview; transcription catches up independently.
- Waveform scrubbing, playback speed controls, and transcript editing.
- Existing-audio import, WAV/MP3 export, and clipboard copy.
- Multilingual Tiny, Base and Small Q5 models download separately in the app.

Install the attached APK on Android 8.0+ ARM64 devices (x86-64 is also included). Check the attached verification report for the exact tests and limitations of this version. This is the Android release stream; desktop installers are published under `v*` tags.

Updates require the same signing key. A release-signed APK cannot replace a debug-signed installation with a different key. Export recordings before uninstalling any existing installation; uninstalling deletes its private recordings.
